ruleDefinitions.name: CredUI.DLL Loaded By Uncommon Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects loading of "credui.dll" and related DLLs by an uncommon process. Attackers might leverage this DLL for potential use of "CredUIPromptForCredentials" or "CredUnPackAuthenticationBufferW". Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\credui\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\wincredui\\\.dll$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "credui\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "wincredui\.dll")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\ImmersiveControlPanel\\SystemSettings\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\regedit\.exe")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\_autoupdate\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\procexp64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procexp\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\Teams\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\Teams\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\OneDrive\\\\.*")))
